title: Idle Stellar
description:
The galaxy is under attack and awaits your valor and skill in the face of looming peril. Join the ranks and let your journey to bring stability and order to the outer borders of the cosmos begin!

• Mine asteroids for precious metals and minerals.

• Harvest space clouds to discover exotic gases and chemicals.

• Salvage wrecks for spare parts and lost artifacts.

• Engage in battles against local factions for loot, experience, and glory.

• Select the right gear to counter your enemies.

• Unleash special abilities to turn the tide of battle in your favor.

• Recruit crew members to assist you on your journey, even while offline.

• Craft resources, fuse powerful chipsets, and unlock scientific advancements.

• Prioritize your upgrades to suit your playstyle, whether it's active, idle, or both.

• Enhance your ship modules to improve your gathering and combat capabilities.

• Level up your crew members to unlock new mechanics and perks

Join the ranks of the galactic empire and prepare to stand against the impending invasion!
description_short: Embark on an epic adventure through the cosmos in Idle Stellar. Gather, craft and upgrade your spaceship to destroy your enemies. Play actively or relax into idle progression as you experience the feature-rich journey ahead!
